decisions: Associated type names retain source order. Method fields retain source order, include self ownership and return spelling, then additional parameter count and each parameter type/ownership. Parameter names are intentionally absent, matching CSharp.
Self and input aliases reuse the owning method AST node. Exclude those synthetic symbols when collecting additional parameters; retain explicit additional parameters in source order.

Type spelling reuses the same live TypeAnnotation context with active trait-associated names. Empty traits provide empty associated/method groups, not absent required bindings.
Trait-specific facts return one owned TraitFields record. The caller binds generated rule parts; the shared rule owns field-group order.
